reason: Schema values in src/tool wrap z.object in lazySchema(() => zodSchema(...)), including empty tool inputs (web-search.ts:32, mcp.ts:68, image-generation.ts:40, web-search-preview.ts:25). fileSearch (file-search.ts:146) is the only factory that inlines a raw z.object({}) as inputSchema. It compiles because FlexibleSchema accepts a raw ZodSchema (provider-utils schema.ts:82), and no oxlint rule covers it, so it is a drift from house style that could easily have been avoided (R8), not a different kind of member: the other factories don't call z.object and aren't flagged, which refutes reviewer 1's 'every new factory' concern. That leaves 1 of 1 counted outliers as look, so ACCEPT. The wording 'call zodSchema() before z.object()' really means 'wrap z.object in zodSchema', and unflagged sub-schema helpers (comparisonFilterSchema, safetyCheckSchema) stay unwrapped, so clear=false. Hesitated with WRONG mixed_group.
